command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R1 (WARNING, main_page_grid_view_e2e.feature:1) states a false fact: its Problem says 'The view contract has no reorder scenario' and that the reorder features run only on Cards. In fact locations_view_contract_e2e.feature:30-40 'Device time location under contract' is tagged @view-contract with no pending tag, so it runs in the view-contract-grid project (playwright.bdd.config.ts:77-92). It does a keyboard reorder in Grid: 'When the user picks up "Almaty" with the keyboard / And the user moves the picked-up card up 1 time / And the user drops the picked-up card with the keyboard'. The pick-up step (locations_reorder_drag_e2e.steps.ts:126-133) focuses the move handle, presses Space and expects the 'picked up' announcement. R1's Impact example ('the move handle hidden') would already fail CI in Grid. The only real gap is that no Grid test checks the list order after a reorder (that scenario removes the moved row before 'Then the locations list order is "Moscow"'). Rewrite R1's Problem and Impact to that narrower gap, citing the existing contract scenario.

Requirements lines FR7 and NFR-A2 are marked ⚠️ with the evidence 'keyboard reordering in Grid is not exercised (see R1)', which is untrue (see above: keyboard pick-up, move and drop run in Grid in the view-contract scenario 'Device time location under contract'). Correct the evidence so it says only that the order after a reorder is not checked in Grid.
